scope: Single-entry quality review of Meshy. Verified its current AI 3D creation workflow and free/paid offering; no catalog expansion or lifecycle change.

accepted.name: Meshy
accepted.description: AI 3D creation workspace for generating models from text, images or chat, then texturing, rigging, animating and optimizing assets for games, design and 3D printing. Includes an API and MCP integration.
accepted.userValue: For game developers, 3D artists and makers who need to prototype characters, props and printable concepts without building every model manually. Outputs are not CAD-precision engineering parts; free-tier credits and asset licensing differ from paid plans.

notes: The official product and documentation pages describe text/image/chat-to-3D creation, AI texturing, rigging and animation, optimization, 3D printing workflows, exports and API/MCP integration.
Meshy is positioned for creative 3D assets and prototyping, not CAD-precision engineering parts.
Free access is credit-limited and the license/asset privacy terms vary by plan; users should check the current plan terms before commercial use.
